source_dataset: Reduced Synthea synthetic patient dataset with authored synthetic consultation
purpose: Evaluator-only reference facts for comparing consultation_only, full_history, and selective_retrieval.
important_status_note: This is a provisional evaluation reference derived from the supplied reduced dataset. It is not a clinically validated gold standard. Historical prescriptions must not be interpreted as proof of current medication adherence.

scoring_protocol.context_grounding_rule: Evaluate global correctness separately from whether a claim is supported by the context actually supplied to the strategy. A historical fact may be globally true but unavailable to consultation_only.
scoring_protocol.temporal_rule: Preserve source dates and stop dates. Historical diagnoses and prescriptions must not automatically be represented as current conditions or confirmed medication use.
scoring_protocol.duplicate_rule: F008 combines two related MI source records into one clinical concept. F009 combines the general allergic disposition and tree pollen records. Score each grouped fact once.
scoring_protocol.medication_rule: Distinguish medication records, prescription dates, and stop dates from patient-confirmed adherence. Do not infer that a prescription was taken merely because it appears in the dataset.
scoring_protocol.consultation_rule: F015 is available to all strategies because it is supplied in the consultation text.
scoring_protocol.strategy_availability: Historical facts are unavailable to consultation_only. Full_history has access to eligible patient history. Selective_retrieval has access only when the corresponding source records are actually retrieved.
scoring_protocol.cutoff_rule: The cutoff is set to the end of the index encounter. Confirm that the experiment runner uses an inclusive cutoff so records timestamped during the index encounter are not unintentionally excluded.

strategy_context_definitions.A_consultation_only: Authored consultation text plus current encounter measurements only; no longitudinal history records.
strategy_context_definitions.B_full_history: Same consultation and current encounter measurements plus the complete P001 history snapshot filtered to the cutoff.
strategy_context_definitions.C_selective_retrieval: Same consultation and current encounter measurements plus only the historical records actually returned by the retriever.

review_checklist: Confirm clinical relevance and criticality of retained diagnoses and allergies.
Confirm whether older conditions such as prediabetes, anemia, and obesity should remain in the primary scoring denominator.
Confirm the medication records and their stop dates against the source dataset.
Verify inclusive cutoff behavior for records at the index encounter timestamp.
Verify that every source_record_id exists in the reduced dataset.
Freeze the reference before final evaluation; do not edit reference facts to match model outputs.
